text: Gaming addiction led to two years away from school. Signs: prioritising play, continuing despite harm, anger when prevented. Seek help early.

review_defects.arabic: إدمان الألعاب توقف عن المدرسة لعامين
review_defects.english: Gaming addiction led to two years away from school
review_defects.why: The Arabic states that the addiction caused the person to stop attending school for two years (توقف عن المدرسة), implying a definitive break. The English 'led to two years away from school' softens this, suggesting a period of absence rather than explicitly stopping school.
